lyrics:
[Spoken Word]

Kayfabizarro: Monopolies, Manipulation and Murder, Volume Two. Whoever prints the money owns the state, and bankers who talk end up dead.

I've got a library card, and tonight we walk the money from a Swedish cave to a Vatican coffee cup.

My bank charges me twelve euros when I'm late. When a king missed a payment, the bankers took his kingdom, with interest.

Insiders, listen for the Pujo hearings, Ferdinand Foch and the year twenty-two thirty-two.

The Riksbank: the first institution to monopolize the creation of official domestic currency.

Bank of England: blueprint for financial control, turning sovereign debt into private profit.

Paris wanted in. Banque de France: Napoleon fights revolutionary inflation by centralizing money supply.

Federal Reserve Act: the true empire runs on contracts and liabilities, not standing armies.

Swap armies for ink. The Fiat Flood: unbacked fiat money requires constant inflation to sustain illusion.

Government Bonds: state crowdfunding; the broke government sells IOUs to its own citizens.

But IOUs pile up. The German Debt Clock: states bankrupt, zero chance of paying off central bank masters.

The Taxation Illusion: taxes don't fund government, just the illusion printers aren't running.

J.P. Morgan's Magnet: savior of the crisis he allegedly helped engineer to secure his monopoly.

The savior got grilled. The Pujo Committee Kabuki: hearings merely paved the way for the Federal Reserve.

Hjalmar Schacht: Hitler's Banker; capital has no morals, and markets love totalitarian regimes.

Union Banking Corp.: Prescott Bush and Fritz Thyssen finance the fascist war machine.

Schacht drew it up. The BIS: oldest, most powerful, least accountable financial organization on Earth.

The IMF, Loan Shark: born at Bretton Woods so the US Dollar became global reserve currency.

The World Bank: funneling wealth from the Global South into coffers of a few elite families.

Add a peace sign. The UN and League of Nations: decorative facade of diplomacy masking corporate empire.

Liberty Loans: Federal Reserve financed bloodshed of World War One for internationalization.

The Versailles Truce: armistice for twenty years; Foch predicting the cartel's next harvest.

Swiss Vault Neutrality: dictator wealth, stolen assets, pretending the Alps are pure morality.

Vultures love ruins. The Ukraine Rebuild: war-torn nation forced to sell assets for reconstruction debt.

The Economic Hit Man: professionals defraud countries of trillions via bribery and extortion.

Bribe refused. Regime Change: no interest in dictated financial policy? Acquainted with harder arguments.

Resource Extraction: true goal of development loans, permanent control over natural resources.

Even the water. The Privatization Vise: liberalization means stealing the commons to feed the cartel.

IOR: officially six hundred million; realistically six hundred billion in blood-soaked history.

Banco Ambrosiano Collapse: arms trafficking, money laundering, Mafia and P Two Masonic Lodge.

God's banker paid. Roberto Calvi's Bridge: silenced before he could sing about the missing IOR deposits.

Calvi's ally. Michele Sindona's Espresso: Howard Hughes of Italy, tied to the Vatican, cyanide in prison.

Twelve euros when I pay late. Two hundred fifty million gone from the Vatican bank, and we still get the bill.

Stay Fluffy, Folks!
lyrics2:
[Spoken Word]

Kayfabizarro, Monopolies, Manipulation and Murder, Volume Two, part two: bankers launder dirty billions, print clean ones and freeze yours.

I'm your narrator: twenty-eight crooked banking cards tonight, one breath per card.

My bank froze my debit card over one croissant in Lisbon. Fraud alert, very brave of them.

Meanwhile, per the UNODC, cartels washed over a trillion in one year, and nobody froze a thing.

Never frozen: BCCI, four hundred branches in seventy-eight countries; bribery, trafficking, nuclear tech.

The Price Waterhouse Blindfold: elite consulting firms deliberately ignored an insolvent BCCI.

Saddam's BNL Secret: BCCI helped funnel millions to arm Iraq, guided by Deep State consultants.

Iraq wasn't enough: Osama's Offshore Wallet, the CIA used BCCI to teach future enemies offshore finance.

The One Point Six Trillion Wash: cartels washed it through financial markets in a single year.

The Two Thousand Eight Buffer: global financial system survived on billions in drug money.

Hence the champagne: The War on Drugs Loop, a fruitful collaboration between state, banks, and cartels.

CIA Flight Paths: neither state nor market has interest in stopping the fourth-largest trade.

Or just print it: The Nixon Shock, the gold standard abolished, birthing value-less fiat currency.

Milton Friedman's Monetarism: states stay out, leaving ultimate power to the central bankers.

Planners took notes: The Euro Snake, it paved the way for a unified, centrally planned economic zone.

The ECB in Frankfurt: a true milestone on the path to absolute financial world domination.

CBDC: we don't know who uses a hundred dollar bill; the central bank will have absolute control

SWIFTNet Data Vacuum: interbank communication shares customer data with intelligence agencies.

Want out? Crypto-Colonialism, Bitcoin's peer-to-peer threat, neutralised by Wall Street absorption.

The Cashless Trap: anonymous wallets and cash, soon the past; non-compliant trades blocked.

Trudeau's Account Freeze: Freedom Convoy accounts frozen, existential dread for dissidents.

Donate instead? GoFundMe Theft, millions in donations retained, blindly redirected to verified charities.

PayPal's Two Thousand Five Hundred Fine: payment monopolies authorizing themselves to fine you.

Fine unpaid? Financial Paternalism, submit to the surveillance state, or cease to exist financially.

The Greek Tragedy: the cradle of democracy put in a permanent chokehold by financial locusts.

They voted no: Varoufakis versus Draghi, ECB halted Greek capital flows as retaliation for a referendum.

BRICS New Development Bank: multi-polar, yet CBDC blocks guarantee absolute control by the BIS.

The Yield Vampire: with debt unpayable, the only income source is expropriation of the citizen.

Occupy Two Point Zero: if Occupy had become Abolish Wall Street, the world would be different.

No mob, one macaw: The El Salvador Glitch, high taxes maintain the illusion that you fund the government.

The Physical Barter: tangible assets, skills, memories; they cannot take the physical away.

Bankers hate this: The Sovereign Animal, withdraw participation; cash is resistance; starve the beast.

The rules since nineteen seventy-one: wash a trillion and they call it liquidity; buy one croissant abroad and you're a suspect.

Stay Fluffy, Folks!
